League of Light: Edge of Justice

name: League of Light: Edge of Justice
storyline:
A series of mysterious murders and disappearances has shaken the city, and the League of Light sends you, one of its trusted investigators, to uncover the truth. Evidence points toward a former League member who may have turned rogue, exploiting forbidden magic to pursue their own version of justice.

As you explore shadowy streets, haunted buildings, and hidden chambers, you discover that the crimes are part of a larger conspiracy within the League itself. Corruption, betrayal, and dark secrets threaten not only the city but the very order you serve.

Your mission is to gather clues, solve puzzles, and confront the rogue member to restore justice and prevent the League’s light from being extinguished. Along the way, you face moral dilemmas that test loyalty, courage, and the meaning of true justice.
summary: Return to the famous city of Hamelin to experience a clever retelling of the mysterious flutist who saved the town from rats but was denied his rightful dues. Years later, the infamous flutist has returned to Hamelin, and now he desires revenge! Investigate the smoky spirits inhabiting the town and uncover the truth in this intriguing hidden-object puzzle adventure!
